label: H2 Check dispersion-control + dual-metric confirmatory amendment
reason: The 2026-06-18 matched-scale (pinned-threshold) Phase A diagnostic (T1.5c, commits 5b226f5/c5c4f10) REFUTED the threshold-artifact hypothesis: pinning a common tau left the H2 W2 T-ratio unchanged (auto ~ pinned to 4 d.p.; L=200 T=3.3239, L=300 T=3.8424, both p=0.0). Manager inline scoping (User-approved 2026-06-18; persistence-floor + birth/death-location analysis on the committed Phase A diagrams + PROJ_ROOT checkpoints, null-null reproduced exactly at 1.865) then identified the true mechanism: the observed H2 diagram is the Markov-1 null H2 diagram SHIFTED ~35% to larger birth/death coordinates with similar persistence spans (L=200 obs birth median 15.03 vs null 11.15, death 16.26 vs 11.48; L=300 obs birth 13.56 vs null 10.17, death 14.66 vs 10.48). This is a cloud-DISPERSION shift -- the observed cloud is more dispersed than the memoryless global-Markov-1 surrogates -- NOT a distinct H2 void structure. It is the SAME dispersion that already drives the H0 (T~15) and H1 (T~5-7) rejections (the headline omnibus); the monotone H0>H1>H2 T-ratio ladder is its fingerprint. A persistence floor does not collapse the W2 T-ratio (stays ~2.5-3.6 to floor~1.0) precisely because flooring removes near-diagonal points but not the location offset. The raw pinned-W2 'rejection' is therefore confounded by cloud dispersion and is NOT a valid basis for 'expand to H2'; mechanically applying the pinned-W2 rule would double-count the H0/H1 signal as a spurious higher-dimensional section. Per the project dual-metric mandate (no H-conclusion rests on W2 alone), the decision requires a scale-normalized dual-metric test before any direction is locked.

fix.name: scale-normalized dual-metric H2 Check (dispersion control)
fix.dispersion_control: Before PH, normalize each point cloud by its own characteristic scale s(X) = median of the pairwise distances of the L-landmark sample, i.e. compute H2 persistence on distances divided by s. Observed and every Markov-1 null cloud are each normalized by their OWN s, removing the global scale/dispersion difference while preserving shape. A genuine scale-invariant H2 void survives normalization; a pure dispersion (location) shift vanishes.
fix.dual_metric: Compute BOTH Wasserstein-2 (order 2, internal_p 2) AND persistence-landscape L2 (k_max=5, n_points=200, the project-standard landscape settings) for H2, each with the obs-null distribution and the 500-pair null-null baseline, on the normalized diagrams. Per CONVENTIONS the landscape-L2 complement is co-primary; no H2 conclusion rests on W2 alone.
fix.reference_raw: Also report the RAW (unnormalized) W2 + landscape-L2 at the same settings as the confound exhibit, to show the raw metrics reject while the normalized metrics do not.
fix.threshold_note: Threshold choice is immaterial for H2 here (Phase A established pinned ~ auto to 4 d.p.); the normalized run uses the per-cloud auto-threshold on normalized distances.

entries.name: H2 Check (amended -- dispersion-controlled dual-metric)
entries.decision_rule: reject -> expand to H2; fail -> restriction stands
entries.decision_statistic: The SCALE-NORMALIZED dual-metric H2 test vs the Markov-1 null: W2 AND landscape-L2 on per-cloud median-pdist-normalized H2 diagrams. The raw (unnormalized) and pinned-threshold W2 results are confounds/exhibits and are NOT decision-bearing.

decision_logic.restriction_stands: If BOTH normalized metrics FAIL to reject (W2 p>=0.05 AND landscape-L2 p>=0.05) at both L in {200,300}, the raw H2 rejection is a pure cloud-dispersion artifact (the same signal as H0/H1, not additive) -> restriction stands; no higher-dimensional homology section. H2 is disclosed as the cohort-vs-Markov dispersion already reported at H0/H1.
decision_logic.escalate_candidate: If EITHER normalized metric REJECTS (p<0.05) at either L, there is scale-invariant H2 structure beyond dispersion -> STOP and escalate to the Manager before any prose; candidate 'expand to H2', NOT auto-promoted.

key_params.normalizer: median pairwise distance of the L-landmark cloud

decision_statistic.reason: control for the cloud-dispersion confound identified by Manager scoping, and satisfy the dual-metric mandate

method_provenance.normalization: per-cloud distances / median(pdist(landmarks)); obs and each null normalized by own s
method_provenance.machine_checkable: scale-invariance of the normalized statistic (rescaling a cloud by any c>0 leaves the normalized H2 diagram and distances invariant) is enforced by a binding test
method_provenance.vertex_counts: obs and null both L-landmark (dedup=False); no forced dedup

expected_outcome: Both normalized metrics FAIL to reject -> 'restriction stands' (the H2 difference is the same cloud-dispersion as H0/H1, not a distinct void). A surviving normalized rejection on either metric -> escalate before any manuscript claim. The 2026-06-17 raw rejection and the 2026-06-18 pinned rejection are treated as dispersion-confounded and are NOT promoted.
